Incomplete applications will not be entertained.
Make sure it reaches by 4 December 2026.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Vasantidevi Patil Institute of Pharmacy Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 4 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Vasantidevi Patil Institute of Pharmacy Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 32 vacancies: 1 Professor (Pharmaceutics) - B.Pharmacy, Pharm D & Pharm D (P.B), 1 Professor (Pharmaceutical Chemistry) - B.Pharmacy, Pharm D & Pharm D (P.B), 1 Professor (Pharmacology) - B.Pharmacy, Pharm D & Pharm D (P.B), 1 Professor (Pharmacognosy) - B.Pharmacy, Pharm D & Pharm D (P.B), 2 Associate Professor (Pharmaceutics) - B.Pharmacy, Pharm D & Pharm D (P.B), 2 Associate Professor (Pharmaceutical Chemistry) - B.Pharmacy, Pharm D & Pharm D (P.B) and 15 more posts.

faq.answer: Fill in the application form and send it to The Secretary, Shri Yashwant Shikshan Prasark Mandal, Kodoli, Tal- Panhala, Dist- Kolhapur, by post, to reach by 4 December 2026.

faq.answer: Pay scales as prescribed by the Apex body, Govt. of Maharashtra and Shivaji University, Kolhapur from time to time.

faq.answer: Educational qualifications as prescribed by the Apex body, Govt. of Maharashtra and Shivaji University, Kolhapur from time to time; 5% relaxation (55% to 50% marks at Master's degree level) for SC/ST. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.
